name: Atlas
overview: Service connections and who-sees-what for the Atlas app
description: The server side of the Atlas app. It keeps your server's service connections (Seerr, Kavita, Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent) with their keys on the server, and decides on the server what each profile can use.

versions.changelog: Get: a title's releases as Radarr and Sonarr judge them, grabbing one, a show's gaps, what's missing, and searching for it.
A title read right after asking, cancelling or deciding shows it straight away.
Requests (atlas-app#95): title pages for anything, one state per request, ask for films or seasons, cancel, approve and decline. API 4.
Lists every profile on Jellyfin 10.11.9 and later, where Jellyfin renamed the call the plugin used.
Who sees what, enforced on the server: per-profile rules for Requests, 4K, Auto-approve, Reading and its libraries, Get, Activity and Server. Seerr permissions are kept in step.
Finds Sonarr, Radarr and Prowlarr on this server even behind their login page, and names the app when a key is used on the wrong one.
Service connections for admins: Seerr, Kavita, Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr, qBittorrent and the Atlas home layer, each tested live. Keys stay on the server and never come back out.
First release. GET /Atlas/Hello tells the Atlas app the plugin is installed, which version, and who is signed in.
